findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and placeholder anomalies in platform-runtime

evidence.observation: TODO comment indicating missing query to quality_anomalies table
TODO comments indicating unimplemented Phase 5 Supabase auth and event bus integration

proposed_action.description: Implement database query for quality_anomalies and complete Phase 5 authorization and event bus integration.

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates empty stub lists and incomplete command authorization/integration logic in platform runtime.

findings.title: Direct call to external Gemini API bypassing model router

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable rather than delegating through model-router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM inference through the centralized model router endpoint.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model routing, observability, and fallback behavior for emergency alert generation.

findings.title: Model router call log file is absent

evidence.observation: Configured call_log.jsonl does not exist (call_log_exists is false)

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and writes to call_log.jsonl upon startup and request routing.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into router latencies, failure rates, and model call metrics.

findings.title: Missing routing policy mappings for configured router task types

evidence.observation: Router lists 25 configured task types (including public_source_boundary and intelligence-judgement), but routing_policy only defines rules for 23 task types

proposed_action.description: Add explicit routing policy entries for public_source_boundary and intelligence-judgement.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents unhandled routing requests or silent fallback behavior for missing task types.
